Maya S: Quick sync — AstraGen enablement office hours for next week. Need to lock host rotation, agenda, feedback capture, and confirm Zoom + calendar invites. Renewal flagged by CSM (adoption dip) so propose 1.5h hands-on + Q&A. Who can host the APAC-friendly slot (Tue 8:00am PT / Wed 00:00 UTC)?

Liam T: I can host the APAC slot Tue 8:00am PT. I’ll cover dedicated migration checklist and common gotchas. +1 to capture a short post-session survey.

cs_ops: Calendar created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/asttragen-enable-1729983210 · Zoom link set -> https://zoom.us/j/123456789 · RSVP: add to guest list. (Auto-reminders: 24h + 1h)

Juno (bot): Quick poll posted — react with :thumbsup: for Tue host, :raised_hands: for Wed fallback, :question: if unsure. Poll closes Friday 17:00 PT.

Maya S: Agenda draft:
```
- 0-10m: intros + goals alignment (CS + Eng reps)
- 10-40m: guided migration walkthrough (hands-on)
- 40-70m: common failure modes + troubleshooting recipes
- 70-90m: cost optimization quick tips + Q&A
```
Any other asks or must-cover customer scenarios?

Priya K: Suggest adding a 5–10m segment for 'post-migration verification' checklist and a link to the automated smoke tests. Customers keep hitting tokenization mismatches.

Liam T: Noted — I’ll add post-migration verification between 40–50m and move cost tips to 50–60m. I’ll prepare 3 quick slides on batching/quant profiles.

cs_ops: Added survey link to calendar description: https://rwd.io/survey/astragen · Also added file attachments section and CSM contact.

Maya S: Thanks — @Priya K @Liam T please upload slide snippets + verification checklist to #cs-resources by EOD Friday so we can attach to the invite. Also tag any renewal risk items in the thread so AE can start outreach.

Priya K: Uploaded v1 checklist + notes -> https://files.redwood.com/astragen-checklist-v1.pdf :white_check_mark:

Liam T: Slides uploaded to the folder and linked in calendar. I’ll run a dry-run with CS on Monday 09:30 PT.

Maya S: Perfect — I’ll send a brief pre-read and the survey to the account 48h before. Leaving this open for any final agenda tweaks. :rocket:
